media.provenance: Local editorial brand tiles prepared for stable rendering. They are not represented as official product screenshots or independent usage evidence.

stableProductBoundary.positioning: AI meeting capture, transcription, summaries, action items, searchable conversation history, and meeting-knowledge workflows for individuals and teams.
bestFit: Meeting-heavy individuals and teams that can notify participants and review transcripts
Teams comparing searchable meeting history, summaries, action items, and integrations
Organizations prepared to define recording, sharing, retention, export, and offboarding controls
notIdealFor: Sensitive meetings where recording permission, participant notice, or data handling is unresolved
Workflows that need every transcript, speaker label, summary, or generated answer to be authoritative without review
Teams that cannot govern calendar auto-join, automatic sharing, ownership, retention, and plan limits
trialProtocol: Use one internal meeting with explicit participant notice before enabling calendar-wide auto-join
Review names, jargon, accents, overlapping speech, summary omissions, and action-item attribution
Check default and event-level join, notification, audience, public-link, and sharing settings
Export one transcript and document ownership, retention, deletion, downgrade, and offboarding behavior
Record correction time, missed decisions, false action items, monthly minutes, imports, and AI Chat usage

observedOnPreparationDay.basicBoundary: The official comparison currently describes Basic as free, with meeting-platform support, AI Chat, live transcription, three lifetime file imports, and bounded monthly transcription and history.
observedOnPreparationDay.paidBoundary: The official comparison currently separates Pro, Business, and Enterprise by recording or import capacity, meeting duration, concurrency, integrations, administration, security, API, and webhook access.
observedOnPreparationDay.displayWarning: The pricing page exposes monthly, annual, promotional, and region-specific values in the same rendered document. No price from this preparation snapshot may enter the release payload until the release-day billing context is identified and rechecked.
observedOnPreparationDay.governanceBoundary: Official help content confirms that auto-join can be disabled globally while prior event-level choices persist, so users must review upcoming events after changing the default.

releaseDayChecks: Re-open the official pricing page on 2026-09-10 and identify monthly versus annual billing before recording any price
Exclude first-time, temporary, student, educator, India-only, or other regional promotions from the standard reference price
Confirm Basic, Pro, Business, and Enterprise minutes, meeting duration, imports, history, storage, concurrency, integrations, API, webhook, and compliance boundaries
Re-open official auto-join, auto-share, AI Chat, security, downgrade, ownership, retention, and deletion documentation
Run production duplicate and fallback preflight with --as-of=2026-09-10 --online
Generate data/collection/otter-ai-release.json with reviewedAt=2026-09-10 only after all volatile facts pass
Run release in rollback mode before any --commit operation
After deployment, verify aliases, both canonical locales, noindex, sitemap exclusion, index consistency, and production SEO smoke
